baseline.model: T105 heads on the engine's own readings, headline plus teaser, direction AUROC

prediction.metric: direction AUROC on held-out engine stories, mixed training
prediction.why: T105 gave 0.7221 for direction with the engine's readings alone (runs/pulse/t105/t105_engine_heads.json); a smoke run on 1,500 Jev labels and 2 folds (my run, before this prediction, not scored) gave 0.691 mixed against 0.721 engine-only, so Jev direction labels look weaker than Clef's; presence AUROC expected 0.76 to 0.82 against 0.7936; the call is whether mixing helps, not whether it passes the bars
